english.title: Excess weight - cause use of an articulated vehicle exceeding maximum laden weight

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CONSTRUCTION and USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), an articulated vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when its laden weight exceeded the maximum permitted laden weight of **(..SPECIFY MAXIMUM WEIGHT..).
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 77(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

(i) See column 2 of the table to regulation 77 for applicable classes of vehicle and column 3 for the relevant maximum permitted laden weight.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.

The maximum permitted laden weight for the vehicle was **(..SPECIFY MAXIMUM WEIGHT..) kgs . The vehicle exceeded such weight by **(..SPECIFY EXCESS WEIGHT..) kgs . other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
